'''''Ryntail''''' was the personal [[Yacht/Legends|yacht]] of [[Tan Dicium]], a [[Prince/Legends|princeling]] from the celestial body [[Sifuchi]].<ref name="Threat" /> It partially shared its name with the [[Ryn/Legends|Ryn]], a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] with tails.<ref name="Ryn">{{CSWECite|III|118|Ryn}}</ref> Sometime between [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] and around two [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]],<ref name="Date">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20040122threat|text=Triplet Threat|int=Triplet Threat}} is set in the [[Rebellion era]] and features [[Merl]], [[Uri]], and [[Glocken]], who all [[Death/Legends|perish]] in [[Star Wars (1977) 29|''Star Wars'' (1977) 29]]. {{Blog|holocron|24|Star Wars Eras}} dates the beginning of the Rebellion era to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], while ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' establishes that the events of the [[Star Wars (1977) 35|thirty-fifth issue]] of the [[1977]] [[Star Wars (1977)|''Star Wars'']] ongoing [[Star Wars comic books|comic-book]] series took place by around two [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], or [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].</ref> Dicium visited<ref name="Threat" /> the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Merchant/Legends|trade]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Tirahnn/Legends|Tirahnn]] along with his four [[Yuzzem]] [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguards]].<ref name="Threat" />

==Behind the scenes==
''Ryntail'' was introduced in "[[Triplet Threat]]," a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] mini-adventure written by [[Jason Fry]] for use with [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' and published on [[Wizards.com]] on [[January 22]], [[2004]].<ref name="Threat" />
